An exact beta integral yields the leading first-derivative coefficient, the cubic displacement and the sixth-order sharp probability-gain coefficient. Algebra proves the signed reciprocal identity. The standalone verifier executed 244 finite independent checks, including direct time propagation; no finite computation is asserted to prove the asymptotic result.
